Marta (People Ops): dropping the compact manager+HR onboarding checklist i want to standardize across teams. asking for quick feedback before i publish monday. :memo:

Marta (People Ops): includes day-by-day first-week agenda, a 30/60/90 prompt list for managers, hr paperwork timeline, and a 48hr pre-day email template.

Marta (People Ops): ```
First-week (high level):
- Pre-day (48h): prep email, calendar invites, buddy assignment.
- Day 0: equipment shipped + slack invite.
- Day 1: people-ops welcome (9am), HR forms & benefits (10am), team kickoff + manager 1:1 (2pm).
- Day 2: security & SSO, MDM enroll, grant repo/cloud access.
- Day 3: product walkthrough + codebase tour.
- Day 4: paired work with buddy, small task.
- Day 5: manager check-in, draft 30/60/90, schedule recurring 1:1s.

Manager prompts (to share by day 7):
- 30d: meet key stakeholders, get dev env working, complete trainings.
- 60d: deliver a small milestone, own a task.
- 90d: ownership area + success metric.

HR: I-9 & payroll day 1, benefits enrollment within 30 days, probation check at 60 days.

Pre-day email (48h): org chart, timezone note, 5-min product primer, buddy intro.
```

Owen (Eng Manager): looks good. request: add a 30-minute "team kickoff template" (intros, priorities, expectations, logistics).

Marta (People Ops): will add that.

Lina (HR): add accessibility and accommodation ask in pre-day email; also note parental leave info if relevant.

Sam (IT): confirm: devices shipped day 0, admin access day 2 after MDM. include monitor adapter preference. I'll add asset-tracking link.

Nora (New Hire): thanks! quick q: what should i read before day 1?

Marta (People Ops): short pre-reads only: product one-pager and repo README. we'll send links in the 48h email.

onboard-bot: Created doc: https://redwood-internal/docs/onboarding/compact-manager-hr-checklist :link:

Owen (Eng Manager): no objections. i'll use this as the default for my new hires.

Marta (People Ops): thanks everyone. publishing EOD unless other comments. :rocket:
